periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 45-60 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, angled downwards and outwards towards the cheek.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval; the longitudinal axis is significantly greater than the transverse width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering toward the lateral-inferior margin, creating a teardrop-like profile.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High thickness; the lateral portion of the band covers approximately 35-40% of the visible torso height.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly rounded with a slight flattening at the superior apex of the visible ear.

other_distinctive_markers: The ventral and lower-flank fur exhibits a distinct yellowish-brown chromatic shift compared to the brighter white cranial pelage.
